claim: Supersedes lesson_1ba604860660, narrowing its two mypy claims to only the exact tested context, per direct review feedback that the original overclaimed generality. Both findings were verified specifically against: repo diazMelgarejo/orama-system, working directory the repo root, Python 3.12.3, mypy 2.3.1 (note: repo's own pyproject.toml pins mypy~=1.13, and the real CI environment installed 1.20.2 -- a different version than what was locally verified; this record does not claim the finding reproduces under 1.20.2, only under the locally-tested 2.3.1). Finding 1: running `python -m mypy bin/orama-system/cidf/core/content_insertion_framework.py bin/orama-system/cidf/linter/policy_linter.py bin/agents/executor/execution_tools.py --strict --namespace-packages --explicit-package-bases` from the repo root fails with "orama-system contains __init__.py but is not a valid Python package name" -- caused specifically by bin/orama-system/__init__.py existing alongside the hyphenated directory name bin/orama-system, under this exact mypy version and flag combination; not verified as a general mypy behavior across other versions or invocation styles. Finding 2: running mypy with MYPYPATH set to both "bin/orama-system" and "bin/orama-system/cidf" simultaneously in one invocation, when both bin/orama-system/cidf/core/content_insertion_framework.py (importable as core.content_insertion_framework via one root) and bin/orama-system/cidf/linter/policy_linter.py's own internal `from core.content_insertion_framework import ...` (reached transitively via the other root as cidf.core.content_insertion_framework) are both reachable, fails with "Source file found twice under different module names" -- specific to this repo's own inconsistent internal import styles (policy_linter.py uses a bare `core.X` import relying on its own sys.path.insert() hack, while execution_tools.py imports the same package via the full `cidf.core.X` path), not a general two-MYPYPATH-roots problem. The fix verified for both (separate invocations, MYPYPATH scoped per file group, --follow-imports=silent on the transitively-reached group) is specific to this exact layout and was not tested against any other repo structure or mypy version.

decisions.notes: Direct review feedback correctly identified the original lesson generalized findings only tested against one specific repo layout, interpreter, and mypy version. Superseding with exact tested context rather than editing in place.
